goal: DeepTutorを基盤に、試験固有設定を中核コードへ固定しない択一試験学習機能TJMを完成させる
assumptions: 初期の問題取り込み、レビュー、公開権限は既存adminに限定する
実宅建問題本文は正当なデータ提供まで同梱しない
正式問題と回答履歴は既存AI Quiz保存領域と分離する
npm基準が安定する限りBun移行はTJM本体より後に評価する
既存pass_scoreは公式値へ推測移行せず利用者のpractice targetとして保全する
TJM日本語化とDeepTutor全体の日本語化は分離し、今回の製品受入はTJM導線を対象にする
source-build Dockerを配備の正本とし、GHCR publishと本番配備は行わない
共有catalogと利用者別learning DBを跨ぐ廃止処理は単一transactionに見せかけず、各利用者操作の入口で単調に同期して永続化する
invariants: LLMは正式正解、採点、公開、回答履歴を変更しない
公開済み問題版は不変である
試験提出前の応答は正解、解説、採点結果を含まない
音声認識文字列は確認後だけ正式回答になる
音声またはAI障害時も画面操作を継続できる
試験の問題数、分野名、制限時間をPythonまたはTypeScript定数へ固定しない
レビュー済みrevisionと公開時のcurrent revisionがtransaction内で一致しなければ公開しない
正式回答時間はサーバー時刻を正本としclient時間は診断値に限定する
同一idempotency keyの再送で回答イベント、採点、復習完了を二重適用しない
復習attemptは開始時にlinkしたqueue行だけを完了し、後発行と既にdismiss済みの行を変更しない
superseded版の過去得点と開始済みattemptは有効だが、新規出題と復習から除外し新版へ自動移送しない
invalid_content版はraw履歴と保存得点を削除せず、正式採点表示、分析、新規回答から除外する
過去に保存した冪等responseも現在invalid_contentなら安全なprojectionへ再投影し、正式正解や旧eligible状態を復活させない
公式点は検証可能な根拠資料と一体で扱い、未知の値を推測しない
公式点と根拠資料、個人目標と由来、最大点、採点方式はattempt開始時に固定し、後の設定変更で過去結果を変えない
公式合否と個人目標達成を別々に評価し、一方を他方の代替として表示しない

catalog_revision_review.legacy_policy: preserve immutable review events, exclude unbound legacy publications from selection, and require human re-review instead of inferring a binding
catalog_revision_review.legacy_attribution: use legacy-unknown and the last updated_at when v2 cannot prove the editor
catalog_revision_review.identity_policy: question and question-version identity plus all review events are immutable at the database layer
catalog_revision_review.admin_remediation_ui: published legacy_unverified rows are listed for re-review without edit, reject, or republish controls

learning_timing_idempotency_expiry.formal_time: server elapsed from first presented to first confirmed answer; client elapsed retained only as diagnostics
learning_timing_idempotency_expiry.legacy_time_policy: backfill legacy client elapsed and final answer timestamp only; never infer first presentation, first answer, or server elapsed
learning_timing_idempotency_expiry.explicit_item_open: web hides stem and choices until POST item-open is acknowledged
learning_timing_idempotency_expiry.expiry_policy: now greater than or equal to deadline atomically grades once, records deadline as submitted_at, and returns expired state through read and write entry points
learning_timing_idempotency_expiry.idempotency_replay: command side effects and stored response remain immutable, but replay is projected through current expiry and catalog revocation state; same key with another canonical payload fails 409
learning_timing_idempotency_expiry.browser_retry: first-party key and exact body persist in sessionStorage until completion and survive same-tab reload
learning_timing_idempotency_expiry.answer_change_policy: practice and review lock after feedback reveal; exam remains editable until finalization
learning_timing_idempotency_expiry.voice_race_policy: recording target is fixed at microphone start; navigation and screen mutations lock during voice processing; deadline closes microphone, speech, and confirmation dialogs
learning_timing_idempotency_expiry.independent_review_followup: voice shutdown failure cannot block submit or expiry refresh; Strict Mode restores mounted state; navigation waits for item-open acknowledgement

review_queue_retirement.queue_snapshot: review_attempt_queue_links stores the exact queue row ids present at review-attempt start; submit updates linked pending rows only
review_queue_retirement.two_tab_policy: non-exclusive snapshots preserve the existing API; SQLite first-writer-wins resolution records one resolution_attempt_id without locking abandoned tabs
review_queue_retirement.legacy_retirement_policy: leave reason and retired_at null instead of guessing; reconcile as retired_unclassified and fail closed until a human explicitly supplies a valid later same-question replacement id
review_queue_retirement.retirement_transition: manual retirement is invalid_content; publishing a replacement records superseded and a later replacement id; legacy classification requires a later valid same-question replacement in both service and SQLite trigger; superseded may only escalate to invalid_content
review_queue_retirement.cross_database_policy: catalog is deployment-wide and learning DB is per-user, so every list, start, read, write, finalize, history, and analytics entry lazily persists monotonic disposition and queue dismissal
review_queue_retirement.invalid_content_policy: preserve answer events and stored raw score, reject new interaction, omit official answer fields, exclude invalid items from grading and analytics
review_queue_retirement.superseded_policy: started attempts remain gradeable and historical analytics remain valid; pending old-version review is dismissed without automatic transfer
review_queue_retirement.idempotent_revocation_projection: stored command effects and exact response remain unchanged for current or superseded content; answer, submit, and start replays redact only invalidated or unclassified grading fields and report current invalidation
review_queue_retirement.admin_retirement_ui: published content can be invalidated with a human note; unclassified legacy retirement can be classified only with an explicit valid replacement version id
review_queue_retirement.invalid_score_ui: final and history cards label retained scores as historical raw scores when content has been invalidated

completed_controls: get_attempt_service depends on require_auth and fails closed when request user context is absent
TJM learning storage uses the exact current-user workspace and never calls the generic admin fallback
an active exam blocks new same-exam attempts at service and SQLite trigger boundaries
pre-existing practice, review, and finalized exam attempts are frozen only while another same-exam exam is active
same-exam direct reads, prior submit replay, history, analytics, review queue, and idempotent feedback replay cannot expose grading data during an active exam
expired exams are finalized before the start guard, direct submit at the exact deadline remains atomic, and parallel exam starts create one active attempt
all 21 TJM mutations require one exact allowlisted Origin for cookie-only authentication while validated single-Bearer and auth-disabled clients retain compatibility
authentication-enabled CORS rejects configured wildcard or opaque origins at startup and never passes them to credentialed CORSMiddleware
the network settings API rejects wildcard or opaque credentialed origins before saving and leaves the existing network configuration unchanged
authorization_and_leakage.migration_policy: Learning v4 preserves pre-existing duplicate active exams instead of guessing which one to finalize; it blocks every new same-exam attempt until no active exam remains
authorization_and_leakage.scope_limit: this prevents concurrent API answer-oracle paths in a self-study product; it is not proctoring and cannot erase answers learned or saved before exam start
authorization_and_leakage.outside_scope: the generic get_path_service fallback remains available outside TJM and requires a separate application-wide audit

evidence.independent_review: initial review found credentialed wildcard CORS and unguarded learner mutations; re-review found delayed restart failure from unsafe network-settings writes; after all three fixes the final read-only review found no unresolved P0/P1 or settings/API regression and reran 11 focused tests successfully
evidence.cors_middleware: cookie request from an unlisted Origin receives no ACAO and its preflight fails 400; an explicitly listed concrete Origin succeeds
evidence.network_settings: when authentication is enabled, wildcard and opaque origins fail 422 before persistence and prior ports and allowlist remain unchanged
evidence.next_proxy_smoke: the repository Next dev server preserved frontend Origin, cookie, method, and body for JSON POST, bodyless POST, PATCH, and multipart POST under Node 24 and Chrome 150; Node 22 Docker and TLS remain CP-14 evidence
evidence.catalog_concurrent_init_probe: reviewer observed one WAL-lock failure in three runs outside this diff; primary reran the exact test ten times successfully, so recurrence remains unconfirmed

official_and_target_score_results.official_score_policy: score and human-verifiable evidence source are paired; unknown values are never inferred
official_and_target_score_results.preference_policy: personal targets are stored per user; an explicit null tombstone prevents a legacy value from reappearing
official_and_target_score_results.legacy_policy: legacy pass_score never becomes official; only a valid integer may seed a personal target, while REAL or corrupt values remain ambiguous
official_and_target_score_results.snapshot_policy: schema v2 freezes maximum score, official score and source, personal target and origin, and exact unit-correct scoring policy
official_and_target_score_results.result_policy: official pass/fail and personal target achievement are separate deterministic dimensions and AI is never consulted
official_and_target_score_results.database_boundary: v5 preflight, validator UDFs, immutable triggers, recursive trigger enforcement, exact item scope, and finalized-state guards reject invalid migration history and direct-SQL invariant bypasses
official_and_target_score_results.web_boundary: unknown runtime enums, snapshot or scoring policy versions, snapshot/result threshold or source drift, and item/count/grade contradictions cannot produce a positive result; bounded raw counts remain visible after post-finalization invalidation

local_evidence.storage_review: 149 TJM tests passed with no unresolved P0/P1
local_evidence.cross_layer_review: no unresolved P0/P1; reviewer independently passed Python 229, Web 407, Ruff check and format-check, TypeScript, targeted ESLint, and diff check
local_evidence.publisher_clone: from clean 737e130d under Python 3.13: Python 229, Web 407, TypeScript, targeted ESLint, Ruff, format, JSON parse, and diff check passed

residual_risks: catalog retirement is reconciled into each per-user learning DB before that user's next TJM response, not atomically fanned out to every inactive user DB

TJM cookie mutations are origin-guarded, but non-TJM state-changing cookie routes have not received an application-wide CSRF audit; Node 22 Docker and TLS reverse-proxy Origin forwarding remain CP-14 evidence

localhost frontend origins remain trusted when authentication is enabled; independent review rated exploitation as below P1 because it additionally requires a malicious localhost origin, and remote-only deployment policy remains a CP-14 decision
Learning v4 preserves pre-existing duplicate active exams without guessing, and the active-exam guard is a concurrent API secrecy control rather than proctoring
the generic get_path_service admin fallback remains outside TJM and is not closed application-wide
npm audit remains at high 3 and moderate 2; advisory reachability and fixes require CP-14 evidence
Docker requirements installation does not consume uv.lock
full mypy remains blocked by the baseline Python 3.11 and NumPy stub mismatch
licensed Takken question data and the sherpa model are not bundled
official passing scores and evidence sources for licensed Takken data are not bundled, so real-data official results remain unavailable until acceptance data is supplied
direct SQL can create an empty attempt id, although first-party APIs always generate att_<uuid> ids and this does not alter score facts; malicious local-DB tamper resistance is not claimed

the original meaning of an integer legacy pass_score is unprovable; it is never promoted to an official score and only seeds a user-editable personal target that an explicit null tombstone can permanently clear
TJM workspace detailed copy is English-first; only global navigation follows the existing en/zh catalog
